description: This file defines the PumpStream class implementing a read-only stream that pumps data from a callable source. It provides methods for reading, string conversion, and stream management, used within the Guzzle HTTP PSR-7 implementation.

classes.name: PumpStream
classes.description: A class providing a read-only stream that pumps data from a PHP callable, implementing the PSR-7 StreamInterface

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PumpStream with a source callable and optional stream options

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the entire stream as a string, using Utils::copyToString

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the stream by detaching internal resources

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the source callable and resets internal position

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream if known

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current read position in the stream

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Indicates whether the stream has reached its end

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Indicates that this stream is not seekable

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the read position to the beginning

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Throws an exception as seeking is not supported

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates that this stream is not writable

methods.name: write
methods.description: Throws an exception as writing is not supported

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Indicates that this stream is readable

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from the buffer, pumping more if needed

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Returns all remaining data from the stream as a string

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns stream metadata or specific metadata key

methods.name: pump
methods.description: Internal method to pump data from the source callable into the buffer
